옷니엘 – 메소보다미아 왕 구산 리사다임 격퇴: Othniel – drove back Chushanrishathaim, king of Mesopotamia
삼갈 – 소 모는 막대기로 블레셋 사람 600명 죽임: Shamgar – killed 600 Philistines with an ox goad
여선지자 드보라 – 900승의 철병거를 부숴버림: The prophetess Deborah – smashed 900 iron chariots
기드온 – 바알 제단을 부숴버림, 양털 테스트, 32000명->10000: Gideon – tore down Baal's altar, the fleece test, 32,000 -> 10,000 -> 300, not mighty warriors but cowards
아비멜렉 – 기드온 첩의 아들, 내 아버지는 왕, 이복형제 70명을 죽임: Abimelech – son of Gideon's concubine, ‘my father was king,’ killed his 70 half-brothers, hit by a millstone, told his armor-bearer to kill him
입다 – 기생의 아들, 전쟁에서 이기면 제일 먼저 맞이하는 사람을 번제로: Jephthah – son of a harlot, vowed that if he won the war he'd offer as a burnt offering whoever came out first to meet him; should have read some Leviticus...
입산 – 30명의 아들, 30명의 며느리 국제결혼, 안되는 일: Ibzan – 30 sons, 30 daughters-in-law, international marriages, something that shouldn't happen
삼손 – 제 멋대로 사는 인생, 나실인으로 태어나 전혀 구별되게 살지 않: Samson – a life lived however he pleased; born a Nazirite but didn't live set apart at all.
사사들이 이 모양이니 일반 백성들의 삶은 어땠을까?\n - 결국 사사기의:
If the judges were like this, what must the lives of ordinary people have been like?
 - In the end, the conclusion of Judges comes in the last part.
<삿21:25> 그 때에 이스라엘에 왕이 없으므로 사람이 각각 그 소견에: <Judg 21:25> In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
What shows that kind of scene most clearly comes from chapter 17 on.
18장 1절 그 때에 이스라엘에 왕이 없었고...라고 하면서 이야기를 시: Chapter 18, verse 1 starts the story with: In those days there was no king in Israel... right?
19장은 어떤 레위인의 첩 이야기인데 역시 그 때에 이스라엘에 왕이 없었: Chapter 19 is the story of a certain Levite's concubine, and it too starts with: In those days there was no king in Israel...
그렇다면 저자는 의도적으로 이 모든 일이 이스라엘에 왕이 없었기 때문이었: So the author is deliberately trying to say that all of this happened because Israel had no king. But what do you mean, no king? God is king. But nobody acknowledges God as king. It's not that there was no king; they didn't acknowledge him as king.
17장부터 보면 에브라임 산지에 미가라는 사람이 있었는데 엄마 돈을 훔쳤: Looking from chapter 17, there was a man in the hill country of Ephraim named Micah, and he stole his mother's money. But when his mother poured out curses, he admitted he'd actually stolen it and brought the money back. Then his mother immediately switches it to a blessing. And she makes an idol with that money. And she says she's dedicating it to the LORD. This crazy woman. They set up a whole shrine in the house and serve idols and serve God too, a total mishmash, really.
Look at verse 6. In those days there was no king in Israel, so everyone did whatever they pleased.
한 번은 한 유다 베들레헴 청년이 이 집을 지나는데 미가가 불러서 자기: One time a young man from Bethlehem in Judah passes by this house, and Micah calls him over and asks him to be his household's priest. I'll give you a Grandeur and a big salary..OK? Then some men of the tribe of Dan pass by there, and it seems one of them knew this young Levite. Someone recognizes his voice and goes over: ask God for us where we should go
Chapter 8, verse 6: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
거짓선지자들, 가짜 목사들 항상 자기 멋대로 이런말을 해요. 무조건 잘: False prophets and fake pastors always say things like this however they please. Everything will go great, they say. So these Danite spies go back to their tribe and stir them up: Micah's house has a graven image, a shrine, and teraphim. Let's go take them. Good grief, God's people want an idol shrine so badly they're going to steal it. So they storm in and come out carrying the idols and the ephod, and the young Levite priest catches them red-handed.
“닥치고 따라와. 한 집의 제사장으로 남을래? 우리 지파 전체의 제사장이: “Shut up and come with us. Do you want to stay a priest for one household? Or become the priest for our whole tribe? We'll upgrade your car to a Genesis and give you a big salary too.” And so this priest goes along again.
미가 집이 이 소식을 듣고는 급히 따라 붙었어요. 아니 지금 이게 뭐하는: Micah's household hears the news and quickly chases after them. What on earth do you think you're doing?
Look at verse 25. Shut up. Before we kill you.
그리고는 평화롭게 살고 있던 라이스 사람들을 쳐 죽이고 그 땅에서 살아요: And then they strike down the people of Laish, who were living in peace, and settle in that land. The writer of Judges makes it clear that the idol Micah made was with the tribe of Dan. Chapter 19 says, in those days, when there was no king in Israel... right? It's a story introduced as: since Israel had no king, things like this happened too...
에브라임 산지 구석에 어떤 레위 사람이 첩을 맞이 했대요. 무슨 레위 사: In a remote corner of the hill country of Ephraim, a certain Levite took a concubine. What kind of Levite takes a concubine.... But then, of all people, the concubine played the harlot. And she leaves home herself. He goes to bring back the woman, who's at her father's house. Honestly, if you went to get her, bring her back quickly. He dawdles around, and then the woman gets gang-raped all night long by the thugs of that area and dies.
더 끔찍한건 이 레위 사람이 자기 첩의 시체를 12토막을 내서 이스라엘: What's even more horrific is that this Levite cuts his concubine's body into 12 pieces and ships them off like parcels to the 12 tribes of Israel. So in the end war breaks out between the tribe of Benjamin and the other 11 tribes, and the tribe of Benjamin too, all they had to do was catch those thugs and punish them, but they insisted on hiding them, and it even turned into a war. No doubt they were the sons of some high officials.
베냐민 지파가 나머지 11지파를 이길 수 있습니까? 결국 대패하죠. 겨우: Can the tribe of Benjamin beat the other 11 tribes? In the end they're crushed, right? Only 600 were left, but before the war the allied army had sworn not to give their daughters to the tribe of Benjamin. So they kill all the people of Jabeshgilead, spare only 400 virgins, bring them back, and marry them off to the tribe of Benjamin. Are these people in their right minds?
결론입니다. 21장 25절 그 때에 이스라엘에 왕이 없으므로 사람이 각기: This is the conclusion. Chapter 21, verse 25: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
하나님께서 왕이신대 자꾸 왕이 없대요. 하나님을 왕으로 인정하지 않는다는: God is king, but they keep saying there's no king. It means they don't acknowledge God as king. And earlier, the three things whoever became king of Israel must never do, and the one thing he must do
4. Copy the Law, read it every day, practice it, and teach it.
이런 일을 해야 할 왕이 없으니까 어떻게 되었다? 지 멋대로 했다. 여러: Since there was no king to do these things, what happened? Everyone did whatever they pleased. Everyone, this is Judges.
